BL-SETUP-003.story: The platform is split into modules (Core, Auth, Workspaces and the rest) so each feature has its own home and can grow on its own.

BL-CORE-001.story: You can check whether platform services (database, cache, queue) are healthy with one call to /api/health.

BL-CORE-002.story: You install StellarCrew from the command line — a single command creates the first admin and flips the installed flag.

BL-CORE-003A.story: User lives inside the Auth module — other modules consume it as a ready-made port, without reaching into internals.

BL-CORE-003B.story: The install panel talks to the API — status check and form submission through /api/install/status and /api/install.

BL-CORE-003C.story: You install StellarCrew through the browser — a form with real-time validation.

BL-CORE-003C-hotfix.story: The home page / correctly redirects you to the installer until the system has been installed.

BL-CORE-003D-a.story: The installer walks you through 5 steps — admin, branding, logo, first workspace, review.

BL-CORE-006.story: Identifiers and time are typed in one place — less risk of mix-ups at module boundaries.

BL-CORE-007.story: Backend errors land on the frontend in one JSON shape — readable messages instead of raw 500s.

BL-AUTH-001.story: You sign in with e-mail and password — the API returns a JWT valid for one hour.

BL-AUTH-002.story: The frontend remembers your token — every request carries Authorization: Bearer automatically.

BL-AUTH-003.story: The home page is guarded — anonymous visitors go to /login; in the topbar you see yourself and have a Sign out button.

BL-UI-001.story: The sidebar menu assembles from modules — each module contributes its items through MenuContributor, respecting your role.

BL-UI-002.story: The app has a shell: a 240 px sidebar with logo, collapse arrow, sections, footer — with /dashboard, /workspaces and PL/EN labels.

BL-UI-003.story: Below the logo there's a workspace switcher placeholder — first iteration with a single Default workspace.

BL-UI-TOPBAR.story: You get a topbar with a profile menu — sign out, language and theme moved from the sidebar to the top-right corner.

BL-UI-FIX-01.story: Deptrac stays green — the menu DTO respects module boundaries.

BL-UI-004.story: You pin menu items — a star next to each, pinned ones go to the top (max 5), persisted in localStorage.

BL-UI-POLISH-001.story: Unified Button and Input components — primary/secondary/destructive variants, aria-invalid on errors, Design 2.0.

BL-WS-UI-001.story: Workspace dialogs (create, edit, delete) use the unified Button and Input — consistent Design 2.0 look.

BL-UI-POLISH-002.story: Breadcrumbs in the topbar — a Home icon and a chevron-separated path to the current view, driven by usePageBreadcrumbs.

BL-WS-UI-002.story: The delete workspace dialog requires a confirmation checkbox — smaller risk of an accidental click.

BL-UI-STRETCH.story: Content stretches to full width — unified padding, no narrow container from earlier iterations.

BL-UI-POLISH-003.story: Confirm modals are wider (max-w-2xl), the Reactivate CTA is red like Deactivate/Delete, user-management dialogs render via a portal — no more inherited text-align: right from the row actions cell.

BL-UI-POLISH-004.story: Confirm modals keep a stable minimum height on the body text section — a short one-sentence message no longer collapses at the top of the modal.

BL-UI-POLISH-005.story: The audit log view stretches to full width — no more inner max-w-6xl plus double padding (AppLayout `<main>` already uses p-7).

BL-UI-POLISH-006.story: Informational and warning modals (ResetPasswordDialog, UndoConfirmDialog, AuditDetailsDialog) show the icon in the header text color with no colored pill — only Danger/Delete keeps the red circle.

BL-WS-001.story: The workspace domain is in place — Workspace, Member, Invitation; on install a Default workspace owned by the admin is seeded.

BL-WS-002.story: You manage workspaces over the API — create, update, delete (soft), with permission guards.

BL-WS-003.story: You define your own Workspaces — a tiled view at /workspaces, a dialog with name, color and initials, delete with confirmation.

BL-WS-004.story: The frontend remembers which workspace you picked — restores it after refresh and login, clears it on logout.

BL-WS-005.story: A real workspace switcher lives in the sidebar — popover with the list, a Manage link, a tile in collapsed mode.

BL-WS-HOTFIX-001.story: Hotfix: the frontend stopped sending hex colors — later rolled back by HOTFIX-002; we stay on hex.

BL-WS-HOTFIX-002.story: Workspace color is stored as #RRGGBB — validated by regex, any color from the frontend palette allowed.

BL-UM-001.story: Each user has a profile — a dedicated user_management schema, admin profile seeded on install.

BL-UM-002.story: You create users through the API — every creation hits the audit log with after_state (e-mail, super admin flag).

BL-UM-003.story: A super admin adds users via POST /api/user-management/users — DTO with validation (unique e-mail, min 12-char password).

BL-UM-004.story: You list users with filters — by e-mail, workspace, super admin flag, deactivated; with pagination.

BL-UM-005.story: Super admin gets /admin/users — table, filters, Add user modal, sidebar menu item.

BL-UM-006.story: You manage workspace members — assign, change role, remove; an admin must be downgraded before removal.

BL-UM-007.story: Workspace member HTTP endpoints — POST/PATCH/DELETE under /workspace-assignments, 422 when trying to remove the admin.

BL-UM-008.story: A workspace owner manages members in the UI — table, autocomplete to add, role select, delete modal.

BL-UM-009.story: You see your role in every workspace — role pills (owner, admin, member, guest) on tiles, in the switcher and in the profile dropdown.

BL-UM-010.story: User detail at /admin/users/{id} — status, workspace assignments, account section, last 20 audit entries linking to the full log.

BL-UM-011.story: You deactivate and reactivate accounts — confirmation modals, audit log, both actions reversible.

BL-UM-012.story: A super admin resets a user's password — modal with two password fields, audit entry without the password (non-reversible).

BL-UM-013.story: The users table has a row action menu — three options: Details, Deactivate/Reactivate, Reset password.

BL-UM-014.story: Every admin action carries the real actor id to the audit log — no more 500s on deactivate, reactivate, password reset, member role change and member removal.

BL-UM-MEMBERS-LINK.story: The workspace tile now has a Members icon — one click opens `/workspace/{id}/settings/members` where you can add/remove members and change their roles.

BL-UM-VISIBLE-ADMIN-FIX.story: Super admin sees every user in the Add-member autocomplete — the shared-workspace filter no longer applies to admin accounts.

BL-UM-MEMBERS-KEBAB.story: The Remove member action in the workspace members table moved under a kebab menu (consistent with UserTable and the audit table) — no more inline buttons in the actions column.

BL-AUDIT-001.story: Audit schema and audit_log table are in place — actor, action, resource, before/after as JSONB, undo markers, indexes.

BL-AUDIT-002.story: Modules write to the audit — AuditApi::log implements the shared AuditLoggerInterface.

BL-AUDIT-003.story: You search the audit log via API — GET /api/audit/entries with filters (actor, action, resource, date range, reversible, undone), super admin only.

BL-AUDIT-004.story: You undo an audit entry — dispatcher collects Undoer per module, POST /api/audit/entries/{id}/undo returns a new entry id with 404/409/410/422 error mapping.

BL-AUDIT-005.story: There's an /admin/audit view — table with filters (actor autocomplete, action grouped per module, resource, date range) and an Undo button with an effect description.

BL-AUDIT-006.story: The Audit log menu item appears in the sidebar (super admin only).

BL-AUDIT-LOGIN.story: The audit log records successful logins and logouts — with IP, user-agent and account e-mail. Logout now requires a JWT (POST /api/auth/logout with Bearer).

BL-AUDIT-UI-ACTIONS.story: The audit table has an Actions kebab menu — Details opens a modal with the full before/after state and metadata; Undo stays the same (disabled for non-reversible or already undone entries).

BL-AUDIT-WS-CRUD.story: Workspace lifecycle is audited — create, edit (name, icon color, initials) and delete all land in the audit log with state snapshots, each reversible through the dedicated Undoer (restore previous state or revive the deleted workspace).

BL-PLUGIN-ARCH.story: Plugin architecture — modules installed per workspace (not instance-wide), scoped routing, menu, API endpoints and tables. Research in `knowledge/discovery/plugin-architecture.md`, waiting for an ADR.

BL-AUDIT-007.story: You can undo 6 User Management actions: user creation, deactivation and reactivation, member assignment, removal and role change.

BL-INT-FOUNDATION.story: Foundation for atomic integration tests — DAMA DoctrineTestBundle (transaction rollback per test), IntegrationTestCase base class, TracingDomainEventDispatcher for asserting dispatched events, split Test + DataProvider files. Also covers BL-UM-004 follow-up (real-DB ListUsersIntegrationTest). Brief: `knowledge/briefs/1e-integration-tests.md`, 6 decisions pending.

BL-PERM-001.story: Per-module permissions (workspaces.view, workspaces.manage, agents.view, and so on) — UserRole as shorthand for the full set in a workspace.

BL-PERM-002.story: Symfony voters check membership and permission per workspace — replacing the Admin/User flag at the policy boundary.

BL-PERM-003.story: A workspace owner manages member roles and individual permissions in the UI.

BL-AGENTS-001.story: Admin seeds a catalog of predefined agents (Maja, Viktor, Diego and more) from a CLI or panel.

BL-AGENTS-002.story: You copy an agent from the catalog into your own list, or create a custom one from scratch.

BL-AGENTS-003.story: You assign an agent to a workspace or a project — one agent per place (unique scope + scope_id pair).

BL-AGENTS-004.story: You tweak your agent's name, instructions, color and memory without touching the catalog template.

BL-AGENTS-005.story: Each agent carries memory — types conversation / document / embedding / note; memory can be personal or shared.

BL-AGENTS-006.story: Each agent gets its own context strategy — selection rules (RAG top-K, recency, importance) specified per agent.

BL-AGENTS-007.story: Pinned agents live in the sidebar next to the workspace switcher — with a scope badge and a quick jump.

BL-WSUX-001.story: On large screens (≥1280px) the workspace grid shows 4 tiles per row instead of 3 — better use of horizontal space.

BL-WSUX-002.story: Entering a workspace from the list lands you on the workspace Overview page (new URL layer `/workspace/{id}/overview`).

BL-WSUX-003.story: Sidebar reveals a contextual Workspace section (Overview/Projects/Members/Agents/Scheduler/Settings) once you're inside a workspace — unavailable items are greyed out with a milestone note.

BL-WSUX-004.story: Workspace Overview page uses a dashboard layout with 2 widget rows (row 1: 5 widgets, row 2: 3 widgets).

BL-WSUX-005.story: Widget „Active Tasks" shows what's being worked on today + time spent (PROTOTYPE, final after TASKS milestone).

BL-WSUX-006.story: Widget „Active Agents" shows count of active agents + list with current mode per agent (BUILDER/LISTENER/DISCOVERY/IDLE). PROTOTYPE.

BL-WSUX-007.story: Widget „Tasks Progress" shows overall progress + 3 most recent tasks with status and %. PROTOTYPE.

BL-WSUX-008.story: Widget „Milestones" shows active milestone and progress. PROTOTYPE.

BL-WSUX-009.story: Widget „Projects" shows project count + preview tiles (PROTOTYPE, final after PROJECTS milestone).

BL-WSUX-010.story: Widget „Boss Actions" shows what agents are waiting on from boss (Code Review, Tests, ...). PROTOTYPE.

BL-WSUX-011.story: Widget „Last Agents Activity" shows list of completed BLs in format `BL-ID description commit-hash` + status badge (merged/pending/in-progress). PROTOTYPE.

BL-WSUX-012.story: Widget „Workspace Info" shows workspace avatar, description, created-by, created-at, copy-workspace-ID button. PROTOTYPE.

BL-WSUX-TILE-LINK.story: Workspace tile avatar + name + slug + role pill are wrapped in a link that opens `/workspace/:id/overview`. Hover actions (members, edit, delete) stay separate and keep their own targets.

BL-WSUX-PROJ-SHELL.story: Route `/workspace/:id/projects` serves a placeholder page (header + "Coming after PROJECTS milestone" message). Sidebar Workspace section lifts Projects out of the disabled list and makes it an active link. Prepares a landing target for the Project Overviews widget CTA.

BL-PROJ-ARCH.story: Project layer between Workspace and agents — a workspace holds multiple projects (e.g., TalentBridge API/APP/Yii), each with its own settings/agents/members/skills/flow/tasks. Foundation for most of the remaining vision. Needs brief.

BL-VAR-ARCH.story: Variables/secrets system — keys global + per workspace/project (IP_SERVERA, API_TOKEN). Agents reference via `$VAR_NAME` without exposing values in prompts. Needs brief.

BL-KB-ARCH.story: In-system knowledge base (not files) — shared level + dedicated per agent. Decisions: storage, retrieval, scope visibility. Needs brief.

BL-SKILL-ARCH.story: Skills system — atomic procedures per action (`new Symfony module`, `write SQL`, `verify branch`). Shared base + dedicated per agent. Needs brief.

BL-FLOW-ARCH.story: Flow Builder — agent orchestration in a project (Maja → brief → mockups → programming → CR → security) with optional approval gates. Core product feature. Needs brief.

BL-RUNTIME-STATES.story: Agent state machine — discovery/builder/analytics modes with auto-transitions (e.g., builder → listener when no work). Needs brief.

BL-RUNTIME-WORKERS.story: Worker split / thread orchestration — the agent (Viktor) branches work across isolated workers (worker-1/2/3); workers do not know about each other. Needs brief.

BL-RUNTIME-COMPACT.story: Context overflow safeguard — `is_first` flag + force-clear after context compact, agent rebuilds context from DB instead of using the compacted copy. Needs brief.

BL-RUNTIME-PROMPT-SYNC.story: Smart prompt sync — do not send the full prompt every time, the agent confirms it has up-to-date context, token savings. Needs brief.

BL-SCHED-ARCH.story: Cron-like scheduler for agents on workspace + project (e.g., daily content run in Agentic-Social-Media). Needs brief.

BL-DASH-ARCH.story: Page Builder for a project — widgets (roadmap, gantt, phases, metrics). Dedicated tabs per project. Ties into PLUGINS. Needs brief.

BL-AUTH-004.story: Short-lived access tokens (15 min) and an HttpOnly refresh cookie (14 d) that rotates on every refresh.

BL-AUTH-005.story: JTI denylist in Redis — forced revocation (logout-all, password change) invalidates sessions right away.

BL-DX-001.story: CI uses a ci/services block (postgres, redis, rabbit) instead of ad-hoc fakes — once tests move beyond the API surface.

BL-DOC-001.story: Each merged milestone ships with a short user-facing release note in the PR body — changelog style, no internals.

BL-DOC-002.story: Audit of stellarcrew.dev — compare copy, features and roadmap claims against v2 reality, list stale content and missing screenshots before touching the site.
